name: Turkey cottage pie with cauliflower mash
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in olive oil for a few minutes.
Add the ground turkey and brown it, breaking up any lumps.
Stir in the tomato paste, peas and a splash of water, then simmer.
Mash the cooked cauliflower and potato together until smooth.
Spoon the turkey into a dish and spread the mash on top.
Bake until the topping is golden.
